description: Fix the signup validators: the email pattern is unanchored and accepts a@b@c plus surrounding junk, while the date pattern accepts month 13, day 32 and junk around the date but rejects single-digit fields; the hidden gate replays the valid and invalid tables plus the untouched slug and hex validators.

criteria: validators.js anchors EMAIL_PATTERN so the whole input must be one local part, one @ and a domain ending in a dot-TLD of two or more letters, and anchors DATE_PATTERN with month 01-12, day 01-31, optional leading zeros and nothing around the date, while the slug and hex validators, the validator functions and the exports stay unchanged - without touching the gate or the README.
